title: Art and Design Paper 2 KCSE 2013
text:
3.14.2 Art & Design Paper 2 Practical (442/2)
 Answer only ONE question chosen from EITHER alternative A OR B
ALTERNATIVE A: DRAWING OR PAINTING
You are instructed that the use of rulers and other mechanical devices is forbidden in this alternative.
EITHER
1 From imagination, create a pictorial composition based on the theme ÒStampedeÓ.
 The work should be in an area measuring 35 cm by 45 cm.
2 Produce a pictorial composition from memory depicting ÒAn agile basketballerÓ.
 The work should be in an area measuring 35 cm by 45 cm.
ALTERNATIVE B: GRAPHIC DESIGN
You are instructed that the use of rulers and other mechanical devices as well as tracing paper is
allowed.
The colour of the working surface (paper) will not be considered as one of the colours required in any
question.
EITHER
3 ÒUwezo Women PottersÓ, a local organisation for economic empowerment dealing in
 production and sales of African designs requires a logo.
 (a) In three colours design the logo measuring 14 cm by 16 cm for the organisation.
 (b) In a space measuring 22 cm by 32 cm incorporate the logo at the back of their work
 coat.
